question_pt: Quais procedimentos principais, ordenados por volume decrescente, cobrem até 80% das internações?
generated_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    p.PROC_REA,
    p.NOME_PROC,
    COUNT(*) AS internacoes
  FROM main.internacoes i
  JOIN main.procedimentos p
    ON i.PROC_REA = p.PROC_REA
  GROUP BY p.PROC_REA, p.NOME_PROC
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    PROC_REA,
    NOME_PROC,
    internacoes,
    SUM(internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY internacoes DESC, PROC_REA ASC) AS internacoes_acum,
    SUM(internacoes) OVER () AS internacoes_total
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  PROC_REA,
  NOME_PROC,
  internacoes
FROM ranked
WHERE (internacoes_acum * 1.0 / internacoes_total) <= 0.80
ORDER BY internacoes DESC, PROC_REA ASC
LIMIT 20;
ground_truth_sql: SELECT proc_rea, nome_proc FROM (SELECT p."PROC_REA" AS proc_rea, p."NOME_PROC" AS nome_proc, COUNT(*) AS total_procedimentos, ROUND(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_acumulado FROM internacoes i JOIN procedimentos p ON i."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."PROC_REA", p."NOME_PROC") sub WHERE pct_acumulado <= 80 ORDER BY total_procedimentos DESC

question_pt: Qual percentual de internacoes de cada ano entre 2019 e 2023 foi por capitulo CID?
generated_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    t.ano AS ano,
    c.DS_CAPITULO AS capitulo_cid,
    COUNT(*) AS internacoes
  FROM main.internacoes i
  JOIN main.tempo t
    ON i.DT_INTER = t.data
  JOIN main.cid c
    ON i.DIAG_PRINC = c.CID
  WHERE t.ano BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023
  GROUP BY t.ano, c.DS_CAPITULO
), totals AS (
  SELECT
    ano,
    SUM(internacoes) AS total_internacoes_ano
  FROM base
  GROUP BY ano
)
SELECT
  b.ano,
  b.capitulo_cid,
  b.internacoes,
  ROUND(b.internacoes * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_internacoes_ano, 0), 2) AS percentual_no_ano
FROM base b
JOIN totals t
  ON b.ano = t.ano
ORDER BY
  b.ano,
  percentual_no_ano DESC,
  b.capitulo_cid ASC;
ground_truth_sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, c."DS_CAPITULO" AS capitulo_cid, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 GROUP BY ano, c."DS_CAPITULO") SELECT ano, capitulo_cid, total_internacoes, ROUND(total_internacoes * 100.0 / SUM(total_internacoes) OVER (PARTITION BY ano), 2) AS percentual_no_ano FROM agg ORDER BY ano, percentual_no_ano DESC
